PLAY STYLE

products.title: Siux Beat Hybrid Air 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX BEAT HYBRID AIR 2026 - Light weight for better handling. Ideal for players who want more comfortable handling to achieve better control over the ball. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

If you are a fan of lightness and are obsessed with it, the SIUX BEAT HYBRID AIR 2026 will make the difference in your decision. It is a light racket, with a factory weight of around 345-360 grams. Its format is hybrid and will give us a good balance.

PLAYER TYPE

This model is an intermediate range, therefore, recommended for occasional players, or players with an intermediate-initiation level who want a racket with which they can always pass one more ball and learn correctly.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

As for materials, fiberglass provides a flexible and light touch, very easy to handle. It is a more flexible material than carbon fiber and helps the ball come out easily without having to force the hit, favoring a more fluid and dynamic game.

The use of EVA Soft rubber makes a big difference in the sensations. The impact is soft and comfortable, it absorbs the impact well and reduces discomfort,

It has a light weight, between 345 and 355 grams, making the racket feel agile in hand, facilitating movements, quick reactions and control in each stroke.
